_comment: Provider fixture for the AFTER captures: an Anthropic provider selected and expanded so the
protocol-conditional fields of issue #58 are on screen (type 'anthropic' => Anthropic Messages
protocol, and the OpenAI-only knobs such as apiFlavor / dialect must be hidden or disabled).
cch and opencode are kept from scenarios/cch-opencode.json so the provider list still looks
like the committed baseline's list, and the four stock providers are deleted for the same reason.
baseUrl deliberately has NO /v1 suffix: the Anthropic SDK appends /v1/messages itself, and the
settings help text is supposed to spell out the real request path.
model and apiKey are intentionally long-ish real-shaped values so the capture exercises the
'long value must stay readable and editable' requirement rather than a trivially short string.
